conviction_note: Findings sum +1.1 (mostly an inferred chance of an FY revision against an IFIS bar already 20% above plan, plus a likely H1 profit beat the street has already marked in), while the scaled number is +0.44 = (2*0.54-1)*5.5: abs_move is lifted above the 4.32 proxy because this name's real print reactions are bimodal (H1 prints +19.6 in 2021 when it raised, +15.9 in 2023, -3.0/+0.1 the last two years without a raise), and p_up sits only just above 50 because the upside rests on an inference about a revision Rorze has skipped at H1 three years running, against a crowded margin long after a +33% sector rally since 17 Sep.
bar: IFIS consensus via kabuyoho (IFIS's own site): H1 ordinary profit 20,669m yen, FY ordinary 46,080m yen, against a company plan of 19,168m H1 / 38,241m FY (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=6323, read 2026-10-08). Company plan from the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589778.pdf). The IFIS bar is one source; no second consensus source (minkabu 403, 四季報 not reached), so sizes on bar-dependent findings are kept small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 0.7% of shares (one seller), up from 0.6% (+0.1pt), as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 30.32x (kabutan, 2026-10-08), a heavily crowded margin long with almost no short fuel. No option skew exists. Run-up +15.4% over 20d and +5.0% over 5d; the close went from 3,365 on 2026-09-17 to 4,495 on 2026-10-05 (+33%), and kabutan's daily movers pages attribute every one of those up days to the semiconductor-equipment sector rally, not to company news. priced_lean_pct -1.29.

findings.finding: Q1 (Mar-May) operating profit 10,230m was already 53.6% of the H1 plan (19,088m) and ordinary 57.1%, with semiconductor-equipment orders at a record 42.0bn (1.9x YoY) and a backlog of 62.3bn (+33%). That makes an H1 profit beat of the company plan very likely, although Q2 needs 40.4bn of sales to hit the H1 sales plan (Q1: 37.2bn) and the company itself called sales progress 'slightly soft'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 print on 2026-07-09 (15:30), with the same 53.6% progress, moved +1.5% close to next close after +5.6% on the day before the release. The H1 FY2026 print (2025-10-10, no revision) moved +0.1%; H1 FY2025 (2024-10-11) moved -3.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: anyone can compute the progress rate from the Q1 短信, and IFIS's H1 ordinary consensus of 20,669m already sits 7.8% above the plan. What remains is the size of the beat: Q2 needs ~9.7bn of ordinary profit to meet IFIS, against Q1's ~9.9bn excluding its 1.04bn FX gain, with end-Aug USD/JPY (159.7) about flat on end-May (159.3). So the beat is likely, but only in line to slightly above the street.
findings.independence: SEAJ August 2026 billings of Japan-made chip equipment were a record 597.9bn yen 3mma, +47.4% YoY (https://technews.tw/2026/09/29/japanese-chip-equipment-sales-approach-600-billion-yen/). Industry series, a different source.

findings.finding: IFIS FY ordinary consensus (46,080m) is 20.5% above Rorze's unchanged FY plan (38,241m). Rorze revised its FY plan up at the H1 print in the last two upcycles (2021-10-11, 2022-10-11) but not in FY2024-FY2026, so whether it raises today, with record orders and a beaten H1 plan, is the item the release adds.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 prints with an upward FY revision: 2021-10-11 +19.6% next close. H1 prints with the plan held: 2024-10-11 -3.0%, 2025-10-10 +0.1%. 2023-10-11 +15.9%, cause not checked. Full-year guidance prints: 2024-04 +22.9%, 2025-04 +19.1%, 2026-04 +21.4%. This line moves the stock by double digits when it surprises upward.
findings.why_not_priced: The street's FY number already embeds a large raise, so a held plan is a habit the market knows (two flat-to-negative H1 reactions). An actual raise in an order upcycle has historically been a +15-20% event. A stock pricing a raise would have rallied on company news; this one rallied with its sector (kabutan movers), and 27.5x the company's EPS is not a raise-certain multiple. The probability is an inference, hence the small central size and the wide band.
findings.independence: Consensus from https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=6323 (IFIS). Record Q1 orders from the company deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589806.pdf). Different documents, same thesis.

findings.finding: The Kawasaki Heavy patent case was settled on 2026-08-03 for an undisclosed amount above the 7,429m yen provision (the jury verdict was $48m, with willfulness allowing enhancement to ~$145m). The difference is booked as an extraordinary loss in this Q2, with the FY forecast left unchanged.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The settlement notice (2026-08-03, 15:30) moved +7.97% close to next close: the market paid for removing the overhang. The verdict (2026-03-16) moved -2.6%; the provision and NP cut (2026-03-25) moved -1.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The loss is announced but its size is not. It sits below operating income, the company said it does not move the FY plan, and no H1 NP pre-revision was filed, which under the 30% rule bounds it loosely. So only a surprise in size could move the stock, and that would be sized at a fraction of the same money as operating profit.
findings.independence: The March provision and the verdict amount (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260325/140120260325588890.pdf, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260316/140120260316582107.pdf). Same issuer.

findings.finding: The stock rose 33% from 3,365 (2026-09-17) to 4,495 (2026-10-05). kabutan attributes each up day to the semiconductor-equipment sector rally, and margin longs outnumber shorts 30x with only 0.7% disclosed short, so the print lands on a crowded, beta-driven long with no squeeze fuel.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 print came after a run to the 5,080 high (2026-07-01) and a +5.6% release day, and gained only +1.5% next day before the stock fell to ~3,950 by early August.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it agrees with priced_lean_pct (-1.29, margin_overhang -0.74, runup -0.77), which is why it is small. What it adds is that the run is sector beta rather than a company re-rating, so a print that only meets the IFIS bar has no new buyer.
findings.independence: kabutan movers 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-30 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6323&b=n202609190084, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6323&b=n202609300103) give the same sector attribution; 信用倍率 from https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6323. Same aggregator.

findings.finding: On 2026-08-24 Rorze set up a new Shanghai sub-subsidiary because 'expanding production capacity of RCS is urgent' amid growing China demand. This is company-level evidence that orders continued strong into Q2 (Q1 orders already up sharply in China and the US).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1's record orders (+90%) came with a +1.5% reaction. Order-led upcycle prints (2021-10, 2023-10, 2026-01 +13.5%) produced large positive moves.
findings.why_not_priced: The notice was a low-profile subsidiary filing with 'minor' P&L impact. Q2 orders are the number not yet visible. If the market already held a second record order quarter, the IFIS FY number would have moved more than +0.8% in the last week (kabuyoho, 2026-09-30).
findings.independence: SEAJ August billings record (https://technews.tw/2026/09/29/japanese-chip-equipment-sales-approach-600-billion-yen/), an industry proxy.

findings.finding: The 2026-07-28 Kumamoto earthquake caused minor damage at the Kyushu plant (Koshi), which was idle until 2026-08-03 restart, inside Q2. The company stated no material earnings impact.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance; the first notice (2026-07-30) and the second (2026-08-03) were followed by no clear negative.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced as immaterial. The only residual is a small repair or idle cost possibly booked as an extraordinary item.

outside_window.finding: The new Shanghai production sub starts operating in spring 2027, adding China capacity.

release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6323&nmode=3 (Q1 短信 2026-07-09 15:30; FY 2026-04-09 15:30; Q3 2026-01-09 15:30; H1 2025-10-10 15:30). Today's time is not separately confirmed; the date 2026/10/08 is confirmed on kabutan and kabuyoho.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed. FY plan 38.2bn ordinary vs IFIS 46.1bn; a raise at H1 happened in 2021/2022 upcycles, not in 2023-2025, and is plausible but uncertain. Returns: none expected at H1 (no interim dividend; buybacks historically at FY prints). New-year guide: n/a (H1 print). Quarter vs own 進捗率: OP 53.6% of the H1 plan after Q1, versus 27.8% of FY at Q1 last year (26.8% now). H1 OP was 53-54% of FY in both prior years, so a ~21bn H1 OP would be ~55% of the 38.1bn FY plan, in line with or above history.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive (a possible FY raise and strong orders) against a negative priced lean (-1.29: crowded 30x margin long, +15% 20d run-up). The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward FY revision toward the 46bn IFIS bar, and I looked for it: none is pre-filed, and the company's habit in the last three years is to hold. That is why p_up is only 54 while abs_move is above the proxy.
lessons_applied: Open question 4 (one case where a sized-negative run-in into a print was followed by +8.15%) and rule 1 (negatives resting on public series go toward 50): the positioning/run-up finding was cut from -0.7 to -0.4, because it rests entirely on public tape and margin data already in priced_lean_pct.

Rule 2: confirmed in baseline_tension that I looked for the strongest positive (an FY raise, buybacks); nothing else moved and p_up stays 54. The sum moves from +0.8 to +1.1; the scaled number is unchanged at +0.44.
